title: ADHD-Attention LLM
description: Tested three attention interventions (attention dropout, pre-softmax temperature flattening, and head dropout) on Qwen 2.5 to probe whether loosening attention increases LLM creativity. Delivered a clean negative result with mechanistic failure analysis, written up publicly as "I Tried to Give an LLM ADHD."

title: StatArb Lab
description: A paper-trading market-neutral statistical-arbitrage rig: sector-constrained Engle-Granger cointegration pair selection, an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck half-life filter for mean-reversion speed, rolling z-score entry/exit signals, walk-forward replay with no lookahead, and a "loser-autopsy" module that dissects losing trades.

title: Code Review Council (Claude Skill)
description: A custom Claude Skill that runs checkpoint reviews using a council of five independent QA advisors, each auditing the codebase from a different angle (bugs, architecture, security, future-proofing, performance), who then peer-review each other's findings and produce a unified verdict with a PASS / WARN / HOLD badge.

title: Venture Assessor (Claude Skill)
description: An Anthropic Claude Skill for evidence-first startup idea evaluation: market research, competitor mapping, beachhead market selection, TAM sizing, validation design, and go-to-market hypothesis generation.

title: Risk Lab
description: A quantitative risk and stress-testing simulator using Monte Carlo methods and dynamic factor models (VIX, rates, market, and oil shocks) to analyze portfolio resilience under extreme market scenarios. Built with Python and Streamlit.
